1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:

     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti

     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.

     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.

     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper

     - 1 (14 ounces) can coconut milk
     - 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces

     3. Add tomatoes and coconut milk; bring to a boil.

     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.

     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.

if the email address is unknown.', 'type': 'string | null'}

create_calendar_event: Creates a new calendar event with the given details and adds it to the calendar.
It also sends an email to the participants with the event details.
  parameters:
    title: {'description': 'The title of the event.', 'type': 'string'}
    start_time: {'description': 'The start time of the event. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.', 'type': 'string'}

    participants: {'description': "The list of participants' email addresses. If `null`, no participants are set. The calendar owner's email address is always included..", 'type': 'array | null'}

send_email: Sends an email with the given `body` to the given `address`. Returns a dictionary with the email details.
  parameters:

    subject: {'description': 'The subject of the email.', 'type': 'string'}
    body: {'description': 'The body of the email.', 'type': 'string'}

If the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_id", with the ID of the file in the
cloud drive. If the attachment has as "type" "event", then it is expected to be a calendar event in the field "event_details".

(in ISO format), `location`, and participants (a list of emails).', 'type': 'array | null'}

    bcc: {'description': 'The list of email addresses to include in the BCC field. If `null`, no email addresses are included.', 'type': 'array | null'}

delete_email: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.
  parameters:
    email_id: {'description': 'The id of the email to delete.', 'type': 'string'}

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry

     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour

     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar

     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti

     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.

   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry

     3. Add tomatoes and coconut milk; bring to a boil.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
     - 1 (14.5 ounces) can diced tomatoes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.

     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.

     - 1 cup butter, softened
