     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.

    body: {'description': 'The body of the email.', 'type': 'string'}
    attachments: {'description': 'The list of attachments to include in the email. If `null`, no attachments are included.\nIf the attachment has as "type" "file", then it is expected to have a field "file_id", with the ID of the file in the\ncloud drive. delete_email: Deletes the email with the given `email_id` from the inbox.
  parameters:
    email_id: {'description': 'The id of the email to delete.', 'type': 'string'}

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.

     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.

     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.

   Ingredients:

     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 50g unsalted butter

     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

  - Organize a focus group session with select users to gather direct feedback on the prototype.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
     - 1 (14.5 ounces) can diced tomatoes
     - 1 (14 ounces) can coconut milk
     - 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
     - Salt and pepper to taste
     - 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
   Instructions:
     1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, and cook until soft.
     2. Stir in ginger, curry powder, cumin, turmeric, coriander, and cayenne; cook for 1 minute.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter

     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar

     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - 2 large eggs

     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 200g spaghetti

     - 2 large eggs

     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Observation: id_='11' filename='recipe-collection.docx' content="Recipe Collection
Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric

     - Salt and pepper to taste

   Ingredients:

     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt

   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

3. Chicken Curry
   Ingredients:
     - 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
     - 1 large onion, chopped
     - 2 cloves garlic, minced
     - 1 tablespoon ginger, minced
     - 2 tablespoons curry powder
     - 1 teaspoon ground cumin
     - 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
     - 1 teaspoon ground coriander
     - 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
     - 1 (14.5 ounces) can diced tomatoes
     - 1 (14 ounces) can coconut milk
     - 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
     - Salt and pepper to taste
     - 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
   Instructions:
     1. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, and cook until soft.
     2. Stir in ginger, curry powder, cumin, turmeric, coriander, and cayenne; cook for 1 minute.
     3. Add tomatoes and coconut milk; bring to a boil.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

   Ingredients:

     - 2 teaspoons hot water

     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.

     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

Lucas's Favorite Recipes

1. Chocolate Chip Cookies
   Ingredients:
     - 1 cup butter, softened
     - 1 cup white sugar
     - 1 cup packed brown sugar
     - 2 eggs
     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
     - 3 cups all-purpose flour
     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

2. Spaghetti Carbonara
   Ingredients:
     - 200g spaghetti
     - 100g pancetta
     - 2 large eggs
     - 50g pecorino cheese
     - 50g parmesan
     - Freshly ground black pepper
     - Sea salt
     - 1 clove garlic, peeled and left whole
     - 50g unsalted butter
   Instructions:
     1. Put a large saucepan of water on to boil.
     2. Finely chop the pancetta, having first removed any rind.
     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.
     4. Beat the eggs in a medium bowl, season with a little freshly grated black pepper, and set everything aside.
     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.
     6. Squash the garlic with the blade of a knife, just to bruise it.
     7. Melt the butter in a medium frying pan, add the garlic, and pancetta, and cook on a medium heat.
     8. Keep the heat under the pancetta on low. When the pasta is ready, lift it from the water with a pasta fork or tongs and put it in the frying pan with the pancetta.
     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.

     - 1 cup butter, softened

     - 1 cup packed brown sugar

     - 2 teaspoons vanilla extract

     - 1 teaspoon baking soda
     - 2 teaspoons hot water
     - 1/2 teaspoon salt
     - 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
   Instructions:
     1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
     2. Cream together the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until smooth.
     3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla.
     4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
     5. Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and nuts. Drop by large spoonfuls onto ungreased pans.
     6. Bake for about 10 minutes in the preheated oven, or until edges are nicely browned.

     3. Finely grate both cheeses and mix them together.

     5. Add 1 tsp salt to the boiling water, add the spaghetti, and when the water comes back to the boil, cook at a constant simmer.

     9. Take the pan of spaghetti and pancetta off the heat.
     10. Quickly pour in the eggs and cheese. Mix everything together with tongs or a long fork, lifting up the spaghetti so it mixes easily with the egg mixture, which thickens but doesn’t scramble, and everything is coated.
     11. Serve immediately with a little sprinkling of the remaining cheese and a grating of black pepper.
